![Tubing Conveyed Perforating -](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282128-1032-0139-0000-80cc861cd81d:4)
[Tubing-Conveyed Perforating (TCP)](https://www.google.com/search?q=Tubing-Conveyed+Perforating+%28TCP%29&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwin7qizlpGUAxV7z6ACHc9sI4oQgK4QegQIARAD) is `a well-completion method that attaches perforating guns to production tubing or drill pipe to create communication tunnels between the casing and the reservoir` . It allows for long, high-density intervals, large gun sizes, and underbalanced firing in one trip, improving productivity, especially in horizontal/deviated wells.[[1]](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/perforating/tubing-conveyed-perforating#:~:text=Schlumberger's%20tubing-conveyed%20perforating%20completion%20techniques%20enable%20perforating,intervals%20in%20one%20run%20in%20highly%20deviated)[[2]](https://bighornwireline.com/services/tcp/#:~:text=What%20is%20TCP?,guns%20and%20using%20high%20underbalance.)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/iBfyZB3-fVA)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=azLJIzCtAYM&vl=en-US#:~:text=TCP%20creates%20communication%20tunnels%20from%20casing%20into,high-shot%20density%20guns%20with%20shaped%20explosive%20charges.)

**Key Aspects of TCP Technology** 

- **Deployment & Efficiency:** Guns are run on tubing, drill pipe, or coiled tubing, enabling deep penetration and long interval shooting in a single run.
- **Underbalanced Perforating:** TCP is widely used to shoot while the well is underbalanced, allowing formation fluids to immediately flow into the wellbore, which cleans perforation tunnels of debris.
- **Optimal for Horizontal Wells:** It is often the only method to reach the target depth in highly deviated or horizontal wells.
- **Firing Methods:** Firing heads can be triggered by a drop bar (mechanical), hydraulic pressure from the surface, or electrical signals.
- **Gun Release:** After detonation, the guns can be automatically released ("dropped") or retrieved to allow for immediate production, according to.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3HzpTBvkpNs&t=3)[[2]](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/perforating/tubing-conveyed-perforating#:~:text=Schlumberger's%20tubing-conveyed%20perforating%20completion%20techniques%20enable%20perforating,intervals%20in%20one%20run%20in%20highly%20deviated)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/iBfyZB3-fVA)[[4]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/t/tubing-conveyed_perforating#:~:text=1.%20n.%20%5BPerforating%5D,is%20often%20abbreviated%20as%20TCP.)[[5]](https://www.halliburton.com/en/resources/new-perforating-technology-saves-operator-time-money#:~:text=Evaluating%20an%20older%20formation&text=The%20operator%20originally%20planned%20to,met%20when%20evaluating%20the%20formation.)[[6]](https://perf.com/hubfs/TCP/TCP_Catalog_11172022_.pdf?hsLang=en#:~:text=temperature%20requirements.&text=The%201-3/4%E2%80%9D,before%20detonating%20the%20gun%20system.)[[7]](https://psemc.com/oil-gas/tubing-conveyed-perforating/#:~:text=The%20initiator%20is%20used%20to%20fire%20the,Setting%20tool/propellant%20ignition%20*%20Time%20delayed%20detonation)[[8]](https://www.jetresearch.com/en/perforating-systems/tcp-firing-systems#:~:text=Safe%2C%20reliable%20TCP%20firing%20systems%20for%20high,TCP%20firing%20systems%20to%20provide%20increased%20flexiblity.)

**Benefits** 

- **Increased Productivity:** Cleaner, deeper perforations improve fluid flow.
- **One-Run Operation:** Long, multiple-zone intervals can be perforated at once.
- **Improved Safety:** The wellhead can be installed and tested before firing the guns.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3HzpTBvkpNs&t=3)[[2]](https://bighornwireline.com/services/tcp/#:~:text=What%20is%20TCP?,guns%20and%20using%20high%20underbalance.)[[3]](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/perforating/tubing-conveyed-perforating#:~:text=Schlumberger's%20tubing-conveyed%20perforating%20completion%20techniques%20enable%20perforating,intervals%20in%20one%20run%20in%20highly%20deviated)[[4]](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/10916460701677690#:~:text=Other%20model%20sensitivities%20indicate%20that%20the%20perforation,from%20deeper%20perforations%20and%20larger%20borehole%20diameters.)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/iBfyZB3-fVA)

**Common Applications** 

- High-density, large-diameter perforating.
- High-angle and horizontal well completions.
- Fluid-sensitive formations requiring controlled, underbalanced conditions.[[1]](https://renegadewls.com/tubing-conveyed-perforating/)[[2]](https://bighornwireline.com/services/tcp/#:~:text=What%20is%20TCP?,guns%20and%20using%20high%20underbalance.)[[3]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/t/tubing-conveyed_perforating#:~:text=1.%20n.%20%5BPerforating%5D,is%20often%20abbreviated%20as%20TCP.)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=azLJIzCtAYM&vl=en-US#:~:text=TCP%20creates%20communication%20tunnels%20from%20casing%20into,high-shot%20density%20guns%20with%20shaped%20explosive%20charges.)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3HzpTBvkpNs&t=3)

 The use of tubing, drillpipe or coiled tubing to convey perforating guns to the required depth. Initially, the technique was developed as a means for conveying the gun string on the production tubing, with the guns remaining in the well until they are removed during the first workover.
